effect_keys.stamina_cost_modifier: extra stamina on top of the weapon's cost
effect_keys.damage_type: switches the hit's damage type (thrusts pierce, Mordhau and pommel are blunt)
effect_keys.armor_bypass: fraction of the armour rating ignored (half-sword thrust into gaps)
effect_keys.target_zone: zone (or list: least protected is taken) the blow lands on; only armour covering it counts
effect_keys.aimed_zone: maneuver only valid when aiming at one of these zones
effect_keys.aim_relief: reduces the aimed penalty (all sources together capped at 5)
effect_keys.limb_disable: if damage gets through to an arm: -N to that side's attacks for the fight; a leg: -N to defence
effect_keys.disarm_chance: percent chance on a hit that the foe drops the weapon
effect_keys.target_defense_penalty_next: foe is unbalanced: -N to their next defence
effect_keys.target_initiative_penalty_next: foe loses N initiative next round
effect_keys.target_lose_next_maneuver: foe cannot use a maneuver on their next action (rung, disrupted)
effect_keys.counter_defense_next: your next defence +N (counts toward the +5 defence cap)
effect_keys.strip_shield: foe's shield gives no block bonus on their next defence
effect_keys.ignore_shield: this attack ignores the foe's shield block bonus
effect_keys.requires_feature: weapon must have this feature in weapons.json
effect_keys.damage_bonus: added to the hit's damage (Mordhau/pommel: a crossguard is a poor hammer, -2)

_meta.rules: One maneuver per action (chosen, or the best valid one). Maneuvers never change crit chance or crit damage.

2H_sword.name: Zwerchhau
2H_sword.description: A powerful horizontal cut meant to interrupt an opponent’s attack and counter simultaneously.

effects.notes: Cross-cut from the roof that defends while striking: your next defence +3.

2H_sword.name: Absetzen
2H_sword.description: Deflect and immediately thrust into the opponent’s opening.

effects.notes: Set aside and thrust into a gap: piercing, ignores 25% of the armour.

2H_sword.name: Durchwechseln
2H_sword.description: Change through under the opponent’s guard to reposition and strike.

effects.notes: Change through under the bind: foe -2 initiative next round.

2H_sword.name: Half-Sword Thrust
2H_sword.description: Grip the blade and thrust with precision into weak armor points.

effects.notes: Usable normally from the half-sword guard (owner t98u). Piercing, ignores 50% of the armour; the guard's -3 attack still applies.

2H_sword.name: Mordhau
2H_sword.description: Grip the blade and use the pommel or crossguard to bludgeon.

effects.notes: Murder-stroke with hilt and crossguard: blunt damage; -2 damage (a hilt is a poor hammer, so a real mace or hammer still beats it on plate).

2H_sword.name: Aimed Leg Strike
2H_sword.description: Target the opponent’s legs to cripple mobility.

effects.notes: Aimed at a leg (normal aimed penalty applies). Damage through: that leg -10 to defence for the fight.

2H_sword.name: Krumphau
2H_sword.description: Crooked strike to the side, aiming at hands or arms.

effects.notes: Crooked strike at the hands: lands on a forearm; damage through = -10 to that arm.

2H_sword.name: Scheitelhau
2H_sword.description: Parting strike to the head, quick vertical cut.

effects.notes: Parting strike: lands on the head (only head armour counts).

2H_sword.name: Schielhau
2H_sword.description: Squinting strike, feint and invert blade to thrust.

effects.notes: Squinting strike ending in a thrust at the throat.

2H_sword.name: Exchange Thrust
2H_sword.description: Exchange thrusts by covering and counter-thrusting quickly.

effects.notes: Fiore's exchange of thrust: piercing.

2H_sword.name: Break Thrust
2H_sword.description: Beat opponent’s thrust to the ground and follow up.

effects.notes: Beat the thrust aside: foe -10 to next defence, 10% disarm on a hit.

2H_sword.name: Underhand Thrust
2H_sword.description: Powerful upward thrust mimicking boar’s tusk.

effects.notes: Rising thrust at face or torso: least protected of the three.

2H_sword.name: Alber Counter
2H_sword.description: From the fool's guard, invite the blow and counter at once (Liechtenauer: 'Alber breaks what is struck or thrust').

effects.notes: Counter after a parry.

2H_sword.name: Fendente
2H_sword.description: Fiore's descending blow from the woman's guard, breaking through other guards.

effects.notes: Foe -5 to next defence (guard broken).

1H_sword.name: Thrust
1H_sword.description: A quick thrust aimed at the opponent's torso or face.

effects.notes: Piercing; good against mail gaps.

1H_sword.name: Parry and Riposte
1H_sword.description: Deflect an attack and immediately counter with a slash.

effects.notes: Riposte after a parry. (Old '+crit chance' removed: crits are never changed.)

1H_sword.name: Pommel Strike
1H_sword.description: Use the pommel to strike the opponent, stunning them briefly.

effects.notes: Blunt; disrupts the foe's next action (no maneuver); -2 damage (a hilt is a poor hammer, so a real mace or hammer still beats it on plate).

1H_sword.name: Disarm Attempt
1H_sword.description: Attempt to knock the opponent's weapon from their hand.

effects.notes: On a hit, 25% the foe drops the weapon (no damage roll change).

1H_sword.name: Aimed Head Strike
1H_sword.description: Target the head for a potentially devastating blow.

effects.notes: Aimed at the head; the aimed penalty is 5 smaller. (Old +8 and +20% crit removed.)

1H_sword.name: Oberhau
1H_sword.description: Downward diagonal cut from high guard.

effects.notes: Strong over-cut; best against the unarmoured (slashing bonus).

1H_sword.name: Unterhau
1H_sword.description: Upward diagonal cut from low guard.

effects.notes: Under-cut at legs or underarms: least protected of them.

1H_sword.name: Mittelhau
1H_sword.description: Horizontal middle cut protecting the head.

effects.notes: Middle cut, balanced.

2H_hammer.name: Crushing Blow
2H_hammer.description: Full overhead blow with the hammer face.

effects.notes: Blunt.

2H_hammer.name: Beak Thrust
2H_hammer.description: Drive the beak (bec de faucon) into a joint or plate.

effects.notes: Piercing with the beak.

2H_hammer.name: Haft Parry and Queue Strike
2H_hammer.description: Le Jeu de la Hache: parry on the haft and strike with the queue.

effects.notes: Foe loses their next maneuver.

2H_hammer.name: Hook the Leg
2H_hammer.description: Hook behind the knee with the beak and pull.

effects.notes: Foe -10 to next defence.

1H_blunt.name: Overhead Smash
1H_blunt.description: Mace brought down on helm or shoulder.

effects.notes: Blunt.

1H_blunt.name: Helm Ringer
1H_blunt.description: A blow at the helm to ring the head inside it.

effects.notes: Aimed at the head; on a hit the foe loses their next maneuver even if armour stops the damage.

1H_blunt.name: Beak Thrust
1H_blunt.description: War-pick beak driven into plate or a joint.

effects.notes: Piercing (chekan/war pick).

1H_blunt.name: Haft Check
1H_blunt.description: Catch the blow on the haft and strike back.

effects.notes: Counter after a parry.

1H_blunt.name: Around the Shield
1H_blunt.description: The flail's chain wraps over the shield rim.

effects.notes: Ignores the foe's shield block bonus.
Uses the axe's own damage.

axe.name: Bearded Hook
axe.description: Hook the shield rim or weapon with the beard and pull it aside.

effects.notes: Foe's shield gives no block bonus on their next defence.
Aimed at a leg; damage through = -10 defence.

axe.name: Haft Thrust
axe.description: Strike with the haft end after a parry.

effects.notes: Blunt.
Uses the weapon's own damage (hammer head on a poleaxe is blunt).

polearm.name: Spike Thrust
polearm.description: Thrust with the top spike at face or gaps.

effects.notes: Piercing.

polearm.name: Hook and Pull
polearm.description: Hook the neck, arm or leg and pull (halberd, bill, poleaxe fluke).

effects.notes: Foe -10 to next defence.

polearm.name: Queue Strike
polearm.description: Le Jeu de la Hache: strike with the queue (butt-end).

effects.notes: Foe loses their next maneuver.

polearm.name: Haft Bind
polearm.description: Bind the foe's weapon on the haft and wrench it.

effects.notes: 15% disarm on a hit.
